sources.title: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
sources.authors: Songlin Yang, Bailin Wang, Yu Zhang, Yikang Shen, Yoon Kim
sources.checkpoints: training recipes; small-scale checkpoints via FLA
sources.role_in_audit: Canonical delta-rule linear attention; baseline mechanism and lineage root for the modern recurrent family.

sources.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
sources.authors: Songlin Yang, Jan Kautz, Ali Hatamizadeh
sources.license_code: FLA kernels MIT; NVlabs repo NVIDIA license
sources.role_in_audit: Adds scalar gated decay (adaptive forgetting) on top of the delta rule; the mechanism most production hybrids (Qwen3-Next) actually ship.

sources.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality (Mamba-2)
sources.role_in_audit: State-space baseline; backbone of Nemotron-H / production Mamba hybrids.

sources.title: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
sources.checkpoints: released: 48B-total / 3B-activated MoE, Base + Instruct, trained ~5.7T tokens
sources.key_facts: KDA = Kimi Delta Attention, finer-grained (channel-wise) gating extension of Gated DeltaNet using a specialized Diagonal-Plus-Low-Rank (DPLR) transition and a bespoke chunkwise algorithm; layerwise hybrid KDA:MLA at 3:1; up to 75% KV-cache reduction and up to 6x decode throughput at 1M context; reported to match/surpass full attention across short, long, and RL scaling regimes.
sources.role_in_audit: Strongest fully-open (MIT, released checkpoints, kernels, vLLM/SGLang) production KDA-MLA hybrid; leading 'greatest' candidate.

sources.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
sources.authors: Ali Hatamizadeh, Yejin Choi, Jan Kautz
sources.key_facts: Gated Delta Rule-2 introduces a channel-wise erase gate b_t (key-side removal) and a channel-wise write gate w_t (value-side insertion), plus KDA-inherited channel-wise decay; reduces to KDA when both gates collapse to a shared scalar, and to Gated DeltaNet when decay also collapses. Chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors; gate-aware backward pass. At 1.3B / 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens: Wiki ppl 15.90, LMB ppl 11.41 (recurrent), best overall vs Mamba-2 (16.79/12.38), Gated DeltaNet (16.40/11.89), KDA (16.81/11.68), Mamba-3 MIMO (16.45/11.66). Strongest on RULER MK-NIAH multi-key retrieval (e.g. MK-NIAH-1@4K 37.8 recurrent / 48.0 hybrid). Ablations: both gates help; erase gate b_t accounts for most of the gain.
sources.role_in_audit: Chronologically LATEST erase/write-decoupled linear-attention mechanism; strongest reported retrieval among recurrent families; but non-commercial license and no released checkpoints.

sources.title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
sources.authors: Princeton / CMU / Together AI / Cartesia AI
sources.checkpoints: code released; complex-valued state, MIMO, exponential-trapezoidal discretization; matches Mamba-2 perplexity at half the state size / half decode cost.
sources.role_in_audit: State-space frontier; complex-valued-state alternative to delta-rule memory.

sources.title: Qwen3-Next hybrid architecture (vLLM support announcement + Qwen technical materials)
sources.code: vLLM + SGLang native support; GDN kernels via FLA
sources.checkpoints: released; Qwen3-Next family and successor Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (2026-02-16)
sources.key_facts: 3:1 layer ratio: majority Gated DeltaNet (linear) layers to 1 gated full-attention layer; scales to 65K+ context; production-deployed with hybrid KV-cache manager.
sources.role_in_audit: Reference PRODUCTION Gated-DeltaNet hybrid stack; proves the 3:1 recurrent:full topology at scale with mature runtime support.

sources.title: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
sources.checkpoints: released; hybrid Lightning-Attention + softmax MoE, 1M native context (to 4M inference).

sources.title: The MiniMax-M2 Series
sources.key_facts: M2 REVERTED to full multi-head attention across all layers, departing from the M1/Text-01 Lightning-Attention hybrid; the team reported finding no efficient-attention variant that reliably matched full-attention quality in production (reasoning, coding, agent tasks).
sources.role_in_audit: Critical counter-evidence: a major lab retreated from a linear-attention hybrid to full attention in production. Tempers 'linear is strictly better' claims.

sources.title: Nemotron-H: A Family of Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models
sources.key_facts: ~8% self-attention layers, ~92% Mamba-2 (e.g. 8B: 4 attn of 52 layers); up to 3x throughput vs comparable Transformers. Nemotron-3 Super (2604.12374) extends as MoE hybrid.
sources.role_in_audit: Production Mamba-Transformer hybrid; low full-attention ratio reference.

sources.title: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
sources.key_facts: 1:7 attention:Mamba layer ratio with MoE every 2 layers.
sources.role_in_audit: Early production Transformer-Mamba hybrid; topology reference.

sources.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
sources.key_facts: Directly compares softmax attention with DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, KDA, and Gated DeltaNet-2 on expressivity, memory decay, erase/write control, training throughput, and implementation complexity. Core experiments at 350M params / 15B tokens, with optimizer & LR comparisons, hybrid-vs-pure stack comparisons, sequence-length runtime measurements, and larger DeltaNet runs at 1.3B and 3B. Finding: hybrid (interleaved linear+softmax) stacks generally improve validation loss but REINTRODUCE a portion of the quadratic sequence-length cost vs pure recurrent stacks; GDN-2 reported best overall averages among recurrent families.
sources.role_in_audit: The prompt's referenced July-2026 comparative study; anchors the matched-evidence comparison and the hybrid-cost trade-off.

sources.title: flash-linear-attention (FLA)
sources.key_facts: Reference kernels for DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, KDA, and (May 2026) Gated DeltaNet-2; TileLang backend for GDN/KDA (Apr 2026); context-parallel for KDA/GDN (Mar 2026). vLLM integrates FLA Triton kernels with a hybrid KV-cache manager; vLLM and SGLang auto-dispatch GDN/KDA kernels for Qwen3-Next / Kimi Linear.
sources.role_in_audit: Kernel-maturity evidence: the modern delta-rule family has real, maintained, multi-backend kernels and inference-runtime support.
